builtItems: gcd_divides_linear_combination: (Int.gcd a b : ℤ) ∣ a*x + b*y
diophantine_complete_parameterization: all solutions ax+by=c are (x0+(b/d)t, y0-(a/d)t)
gcd_eq_min_pos_linear_comb: gcd(a,b) is minimum positive linear combination
gcd_achievable: gcd(a,b) is itself a linear combination
gcd_complete_characterization: d=gcd ↔ achievable AND divides all
insights: The null space coprime_linear_null_space is the key: all solution sets are translates of the null space {(bt,-at)} when gcd=1
gcd(a/d, b/d) = 1 proved via ideal: gcd divides the Bezout combination = 1, then Nat.dvd_one
Backward direction uses linear_combination h0 + key*t where key: a*(b/d) = b*(a/d) (both equal a*b/d)
Three-variable Bezout by applying two-variable Bezout twice: get d=ax0+by0, then g=d*u+c*v
GCD ideal characterization uses double divisibility: d=gcd iff (d achievable) AND (d divides all)
